title: Django Project Foundation: Settings Split, Core Scaffold & CI Pipeline
description:
[ARCHITECTURE FOUNDATION]
Establishes the complete Django project foundation that ALL subsequent tasks depend on. Creates the environment-aware settings architecture, security-validated configuration loading, database connectivity, static/media files configuration, and GitHub Actions CI pipeline. This is the structural gateway for Wave 1.

[TECHNICAL SCOPE]
- Settings split: config/settings/base.py (shared), development.py (DEBUG=True, SQLite), production.py (startup validation for SECRET_KEY/DEBUG/ALLOWED_HOSTS)
- Environment variable loading via python-dotenv with strict validation
- Database: SQLite configuration with future migration path
- Static files: STATIC_URL, STATICFILES_DIRS pointing to static/
- Templates: TEMPLATES['DIRS'] pointing to templates/
- Root URL configuration: config/urls.py with admin/ path and todos/ include placeholder
- WSGI/ASGI entry points with settings module selection
- pytest.ini and setup.cfg with flake8 (max-line-length=119) and pytest-django
- GitHub Actions CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml with Python 3.11, pip install, flake8, pytest with coverage gating
- .env.example with all required environment variables documented
- .gitignore for Python/Django/SQLite artifacts

[FILE OWNERSHIP]
This agent owns: config/, .github/workflows/, pytest.ini, setup.cfg, .env.example, .gitignore, manage.py (verify), requirements.txt (verify)
This agent must create:
  - config/settings/base.py (shared Django settings)
  - config/settings/development.py (dev environment)
  - config/settings/production.py (prod with validation)
  - config/urls.py (root URL routing)
  - config/wsgi.py (WSGI entry)
  - config/asgi.py (ASGI entry)
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint and test pipeline)
  - pytest.ini (pytest-django configuration)
  - setup.cfg (flake8 and tool configs)
  - .env.example (environment template)
  - .gitignore (comprehensive Python/Django ignore)
This agent must NOT modify: apps/, templates/, static/, tests/, docs/
This agent must verify: manage.py, requirements.txt exist and are functional
subtasks: Create config/settings/base.py with shared settings (INSTALLED_APPS, MIDDLEWARE, TEMPLATES, AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS, LANGUAGE_CODE, TIME_ZONE, USE_I18N, USE_TZ, DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD)
Create config/settings/development.py importing base, setting DEBUG=True, ALLOWED_HOSTS=['*'], and SQLite DATABASES config
Create config/settings/production.py with ImproperlyConfigured validation: SECRET_KEY must be set, DEBUG must be False, ALLOWED_HOSTS must be non-empty
Create config/urls.py with admin/ path and path('todos/', include('apps.todos.urls')) placeholder (todos.urls created by TASK-01)
Create config/wsgi.py and config/asgi.py with proper DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
Create pytest.ini with DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.development and python_files/tests/classes/functions patterns
Create setup.cfg with flake8 max-line-length=119, exclude=migrations,__pycache__, and pytest coverage settings
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with Python 3.11 setup, pip install -r requirements.txt, flake8 linting, and pytest with --cov-fail-under=80
Create .env.example with SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS placeholders and documentation comments
Create comprehensive .gitignore for Python, Django, SQLite, IDEs, and OS files
Verify manage.py executes without error and django-admin check --settings=config.settings.development passes

title: Complete Todo Domain Backend: Model, Migrations, Forms, Admin & Full CRUD Views
description:
[BACKEND DOMAIN TIER]
Builds the complete Todo functional domain: data model with migrations, ModelForms with validation, Django admin configuration, and 8 URL patterns with class-based and function-based views. Includes query optimization hooks, messages framework integration, and search/filter/pagination logic.

[TECHNICAL SCOPE]
- Model: apps/todos/models.py - Todo with title (CharField, max_length=255, non-empty validation), is_completed (BooleanField, default=False), created_at (DateTimeField, auto_now_add), updated_at (DateTimeField, auto_now). Meta: ordering = ['-created_at']
- Migrations: apps/todos/migrations/0001_initial.py with proper dependencies
- Admin: apps/todos/admin.py - TodoAdmin with list_display=['title', 'is_completed', 'created_at', 'updated_at'], list_filter=['is_completed'], search_fields=['title'], date_hierarchy='created_at'
- Forms: apps/todos/forms.py - TodoForm ModelForm with custom clean_title() preventing empty/whitespace-only titles; max_length enforcement
- URLs: apps/todos/urls.py - 8 named patterns: todo-list (ListView), todo-detail (DetailView), todo-create (CreateView), todo-update (UpdateView), todo-delete (DeleteView), todo-toggle (FBV), plus admin/ at root
- Views: apps/todos/views.py:
  * TodoListView: ListView with paginate_by=10, get_queryset() with Q-object search on title, filter state retention
  * TodoDetailView: DetailView
  * TodoCreateView: CreateView with form_class=TodoForm, success_message, reverse to todo-list
  * TodoUpdateView: UpdateView with form_class=TodoForm, success_message
  * TodoDeleteView: DeleteView with success_message
  * toggle_complete FBV: POST-only, flip is_completed, save, messages.success, redirect to todo-list
- Messages: Django messages framework integration on all mutating views
- Template tags: apps/todos/templatetags/todo_filters.py with custom filters for status display
- Query optimization: select_related/prefetch_related hooks in ListView (extensible for future User FK)

[FILE OWNERSHIP]
This agent owns: apps/todos/ (entire app directory)
This agent must create:
  - apps/todos/models.py (Todo model with validation-ready fields)
  - apps/todos/migrations/0001_initial.py (initial schema migration)
  - apps/todos/admin.py (Django admin registration with list/filter/search)
  - apps/todos/forms.py (TodoForm with clean_title validation)
  - apps/todos/views.py (5 CBVs + 1 FBV with messages integration)
  - apps/todos/urls.py (8 named URL patterns, kebab-case)
  - apps/todos/apps.py (AppConfig with verbose_name)
  - apps/todos/__init__.py
  - apps/todos/migrations/__init__.py
  - apps/todos/templatetags/__init__.py
  - apps/todos/templatetags/todo_filters.py (custom template filters)
This agent must IMPORT from: config/settings/ (via Django settings), will be consumed by TASK-02 templates
This agent must NOT modify: templates/, static/, config/settings/, .github/
This agent must ensure: All views use @method_decorator or proper HTTP method handling; CSRF protection via Django defaults; no raw SQL
subtasks: Create Todo model with title (CharField, max_length=255), is_completed (BooleanField, default=False), created_at, updated_at timestamps; Meta ordering by -created_at
Generate and verify 0001_initial.py migration with proper dependencies and operations
Create TodoAdmin with list_display, list_filter, search_fields, date_hierarchy in admin.py
Create TodoForm ModelForm with clean_title() validation rejecting empty/whitespace-only titles
Implement TodoListView with paginate_by=10, Q-object search on title, filter state retention in query params
Implement TodoDetailView, TodoCreateView, TodoUpdateView, TodoDeleteView class-based views
Implement toggle_complete function-based view with POST method, is_completed flip, messages.success
Create 8 named URL patterns in kebab-case: todo-list, todo-detail, todo-create, todo-update, todo-delete, todo-toggle
Add Django messages integration to all mutating views (Create, Update, Delete, Toggle)
Create custom template filters in todo_filters.py for status badge display
Verify all views handle 404 for non-existent resources; run django-admin check and migrate --check

title: CI/CD Pipeline & Security Hardening: GitHub Actions, Linting & Production Validation
description:
[DEVOPS & SECURITY TIER - AUTOMATED QUALITY GATES]

Establish the complete CI/CD pipeline with automated testing, lint enforcement, and production security validation. This cohesive DevOps subsystem ensures code quality gates and deployment readiness.

**DevOps & Security Engineer Scope:**

**1. GitHub Actions CI Pipeline (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`):**
- Trigger: push to main, pull requests to main
- Python 3.11 setup with pip caching
- Dependency installation from requirements.txt
- Environment variable setup from repository secrets (SECRET_KEY, DEBUG)
- Flake8 linting with max-line-length=119 (from setup.cfg)
- Django system checks (python manage.py check --deploy for production flags)
- Pytest execution with pytest-cov coverage reporting
- Coverage artifact upload
- Pipeline failure on: flake8 errors, test failures, coverage <80%

**2. Linting Configuration (`setup.cfg`):**
- [flake8] section: max-line-length=119, exclude=migrations,__pycache__,venv
- [tool:pytest] section: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE, python_files, python_classes
- [coverage:run] section: source=., omit=*/migrations/*,*/tests/*,venv/*
- [coverage:report] section: fail_under=80, show_missing=True, skip_covered=False

**3. Production Security Validation:**
- `config/settings/production.py` startup checks:
  - ImproperlyConfigured raised if SECRET_KEY not set or empty
  - ImproperlyConfigured raised if DEBUG=True
  - ImproperlyConfigured raised if ALLOWED_HOSTS is empty or contains '*'
- CSRF token verification: confirm {% csrf_token %} present in all POST forms (todo_form.html, todo_confirm_delete.html)
- Input sanitization confirmation: verify no |safe filters on user data in templates
- Environment variable documentation in .env.example with all required keys

**4. Security Review Checklist Implementation:**
| Control | Verification Method |
|---------|---------------------|
| SECRET_KEY env-only | grep -r SECRET_KEY config/settings/ (no hardcoded) |
| DEBUG=False production | production.py startup assertion |
| ALLOWED_HOSTS configured | production.py startup assertion |
| CSRF on all forms | template audit: confirm csrf_token in <form> tags |
| No \|safe on user data | template audit: grep -r '\|safe' templates/ (should be 0) |
| Input sanitization | Django auto-escaping (default), no autoescape off blocks |

**FILE OWNERSHIP**
This agent owns: .github/workflows/ci.yml, setup.cfg, config/settings/production.py (security hardening only), .env.example (verification), docs/ (security documentation)
This agent must create:
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml (complete CI pipeline with lint, test, coverage gates)
  - Verify setup.cfg contains [flake8], [tool:pytest], [coverage:run], [coverage:report] sections
  - Harden config/settings/production.py with SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS startup validations
  - Verify .env.example documents all required environment variables
  - docs/security_checklist.md (security verification documentation)
This agent must IMPORT from: config/settings/base.py (to understand shared settings structure)
This agent must NOT modify: apps/todos/models.py, apps/todos/views.py, apps/todos/forms.py, apps/todos/urls.py, templates/todos/*.html (except to verify security properties), tests/
This agent may VERIFY but not MODIFY: templates/base.html, templates/todos/todo_form.html, templates/todos/todo_confirm_delete.html (confirm CSRF presence)
subtasks: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with Python 3.11, flake8 (max-line-length 119), pytest with coverage, and artifact upload
Verify setup.cfg contains [flake8], [tool:pytest], [coverage:run], [coverage:report] with 80% fail_under threshold
Harden config/settings/production.py: ImproperlyConfigured if SECRET_KEY missing/empty
Harden config/settings/production.py: ImproperlyConfigured if DEBUG=True
Harden config/settings/production.py: ImproperlyConfigured if ALLOWED_HOSTS empty or contains '*'
Audit templates/todos/todo_form.html: confirm {% csrf_token %} inside <form> tag
Audit templates/todos/todo_confirm_delete.html: confirm {% csrf_token %} inside <form> tag
Audit all templates: confirm zero instances of |safe filter on user-supplied data
Verify .env.example contains SECRET_KEY, DEBUG, ALLOWED_HOSTS placeholders with documentation
Create docs/security_checklist.md documenting all security controls and verification commands
Run CI pipeline locally with act or manual verification; confirm all gates pass
